Title: Rohan and the Family

Cast

1. Rohan - 12 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Zoya - 12 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Sunita - 34 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Sunita stands near him.]

Rohan: "What lovely weather!"

[Rohan peeks out from behind the door.]

Rohan: "Mom, listen!"

[Rohan dances to the music.]

Sunita: "Yes, of course."

[Rohan takes the bag from Mother.]

Sunita: "Rohan, look at this."

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Rohan: "That was fun!"

[A strong wind starts blowing.]

Rohan: "Careful!"

[Rohan trips over a stone and falls.]

Rohan (excited): "That's great!"

[Rohan pats his horse.]

Rohan: "Mom, listen!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Zoya stands in the living room. Rohan and Sunita stand near her.]

Rohan: "What a nice place."

[Zoya puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Rohan (happily): "Careful!"

[Rohan writes in his notebook.]

Rohan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Rohan opens the door and goes out.]

Sunita: "I really enjoyed today."
